text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

One day, I find Ines Fujin standing in<n>front of a pile
of Toughness bars with<n>a concerned look on her
face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, listen to this. I was at one of my<n>part-time
jobs yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
A while back, one of our clients gave<n>us a whole
load of Toughness bars to<n>sample.

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
But I shoved all of them wayyy to the<n>back of the
storeroom, and forgot to<n>eat any.

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're going to expire<n>tomorrow, but
you can take as many<n>as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So anyway, that's what happened!<n>It's nice that I
got to bring these back,<n>but there are waaay too
many!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I already tried to share them with<n>friends and stuff,
but I couldn't really<n>hand them out in bulk when
they're<n>about to expire, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just look at them all! What am I<n>supposed to do
with them? It'd be a<n>waste to throw this much food
away.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But eating them all would definitely<n>mess with my
diet... Right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What should I dooo? This ishopeless! I'm no good at this stuff!
choice_data_list: Just eat them all in one go!
How about I eat half of them?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. Yeah, I figured.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I figured that was our only option too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was just getting hungry anyhow.<n>Plus, I'm about
to go do some<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And even if this does mess up my<n>calorie count, it
won't just be my<n>fault! You're my accomplice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You're going to eat them too?!<n>You do realize
this is a lot of<n>Toughness bars, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume, so that's one<n>thing, but... are
you really gonna be<n>able to eat half of these?
Won't you<n>get stomachache?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you're sure. Okay then,<n>thanks for the
help!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But... how about we start you off witha third of the bars? No, wait, just aquarter of them! That'd be a hugehelp!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Yeah, you're right. There's no<n>way I could
eat this many...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a waste, but I guess<n>these things
happen!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm going to go throw these<n>bars away
before I change my mind!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: B-before I change my mind!
